aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, Mother Tulasī, giver of happiness to the whole world.
aarti.pad1: You are above all yogas, above all diseases; guarding from illness, you save from worldly existence. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: O Baṭuputrī, O Śyāmā, O creeper of the gods, O Grāmyā, beloved of Viṣṇu: whoever serves you crosses over. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You sit upon Hari's head, and the three worlds revere you; you are renowned as the saviour of the fallen. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Born in a lonely, wild place, you came into the divine dwelling; the world of men gains happiness and wealth from you alone. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Dark-hued maiden, you are very dear to Hari. His love is wondrous: what a bond he has with you! ॥5॥
